'''Ydnen''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. He was able to use [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to run horizontally along walls, combining [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]] and [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] in order to achieve this feat.
